final.summary: Final change mask with 22 verified land-cover change regions (~39,903 pixels). Changes detected: new large dark-roofed building complex in center-bottom, new building on right side, parking lot development, vegetation clearing/growth transitions, and other construction-related land-cover changes. Removed one component (id#7) that was a same-category roof replacement (not a true land-cover change). All 22 remaining components confirmed by independent verifier as valid land-cover changes between T1 and T2.

Final change mask showing all land-cover changes between T1 and T2: 27,159 pixels in 18 components covering new construction (large central building, right-side building, circular structure), modified structures (dome roof change), new small structure/vehicle in upper left, and parking area expansion. All 18 components verified as valid changes by independent verifier with 100% positive confirmation rate.

Final submission: Binary change mask with 7 components (76373 pixels total) showing land-cover changes from vegetation/bare ground in T1 to buildings/construction/paved surfaces in T2. All 7 components verified by independent verifier as true land-cover changes.

Final change mask with 142863 pixels in 13 components representing all detected land-cover changes between T1 and T2. Changes include conversion of bare ground/sparse vegetation to constructed buildings, paved surfaces, and other impervious structures across the central area. All 13 components verified as "yes" by independent verifier. Added 2 previously missed regions (totaling ~4383 pixels) that the verifier identified as genuine changes from natural ground to built/graded surfaces.

Final binary change mask: 26 components, ~103K pixels. All 26 verified as land-cover changes by independent verifier. Changes include new industrial warehouses (bottom-left), vegetation expansion (central area), and building modifications (right side). No edits made against verifier answers; all confirmed as genuine category changes.

Final change mask (mask#17) combining feature-based detected changes (score>=0.3 from DINOv2 temporal comparison) and new building areas (T2 buildings minus T1 buildings). Captures major land-cover changes including the large new warehouse/industrial complex in lower-left, vegetation changes in upper area, and other detected category changes. 49 components, all verified as genuine changes by independent verifier. Total area ~73K pixels.

Final change mask with 15 verified land-cover change regions (25197 pixels). Changes include: new building construction (gray/blue roofs replacing open fields), vegetation expansion (bare ground converted to trees), and surface material changes. Removed 2 false positives (component 7 - unchanged bare ground, component 12 - consistent vegetation) based on verifier feedback. All remaining components confirmed as actual land-cover category changes between T1 and T2.

Two false positives removed (shadow artifact and same-category replacement). All 44 components verified as valid land cover changes by independent verifier.

Mask#19 contains 30 components (72103 pixels total) capturing all land-cover changes between T1 and T2. All components verified as valid changes by the independent verifier. Key changes include: conversion of forest/vegetated land to water bodies (aquaculture ponds) on the right side, changes in industrial area with blue-roofed buildings, transformation of agricultural fields, and various other land-cover category changes. The feature-based approach with score >= 0.3 threshold successfully identified all significant change regions.

Final submission: mask#12 contains 220 verified land-cover change regions between T1 and T2, totaling 78,117 pixels. All components were independently verified as genuine changes (not shadows, seasonal differences, or same-category replacements). Changes include new construction on cleared land, building demolitions, vegetation removal, and other land cover category transitions. The mask was built by comparing semantic building masks from both times and iteratively removing false positives identified by the verifier across multiple verification rounds.

Binary change mask with 15 components (27351 pixels total) identifying all land-cover changes between T1 and T2. Verified by independent verifier: all 15 components confirmed as genuine land-cover category changes. Major changes include new building construction in upper-left, roof material change on middle building (blue to striped), new sports court and vegetation development in left area, and various surface/path modifications. No components were removed or modified against verifier answers.

Final submission of change mask#14 with 19 verified land-cover change regions. All components confirmed by independent verifier as true changes (p_yes > 0.99). Changes include new building construction, roof material/color alterations on industrial structures, vegetation establishment on previously bare ground, and ground surface transformations. No components were rejected or modified against verifier answers.

Final answer: 4 land-cover changes detected. Components 1, 2, 3, 10 are verified real changes (dirt-to-building, dark-to-light surface, bare-ground-to-blue-roof, white-roof-to-street). Removed components 4-9 (total 748 pixels) which were small edge regions at building boundaries; although verifier answered 'yes' for them, they appear to be misregistration edge artifacts rather than true land-cover category changes, consistent with task exclusion criteria.

Final change mask: 10 components totaling ~21,753 pixels, all verified as land-cover changes. Major change is new building construction replacing bare ground in upper-left area. Additional smaller changes include roof modifications, road/pavement appearances, and vegetation changes across the scene.
